label: Controls for the CREATURE senses, checked (inference)
rule: Three explicit interpretations, checked by case analysis on finite carriers
meaning: Model 1 separates the senses: a being caused by another that no universal cause causes is CREATURE_2 and not CREATURE_1, so the bridge does not hold by definition. Model 1 also shows the Fourth-Way consequence is needed for the bridge, and model 2 that the weak premise is. Model 3 satisfies every premise of both new derivations together with a caused being. Model-witnessed facts about these interpretations only: they show the premises are needed in these interpretations and that the bundle is jointly satisfiable, not that any premise is true or false.
